description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Double Crystarium Mode (Ice, Water) v2], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noel], [Apex Meteor Javelin Ability Tracker] and [Apex Meteor Javelin Level]

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode (Ice, Water) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noel
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of  Apex Meteor Javelin (0~2), removed after using Apex Meteor Javelin two times

description.name: Apex Meteor Javelin Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Meteor Javelin level by 1 after using 7 Ice or Water abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noel]

description.name: Apex Meteor Javelin Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Meteor Javelin level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Noel]
